name: 09-nonstandard-layer-order
purpose: Non-standard four-layer stack recognised from explicit order/roles
reasoning: L1 signal, L2 signal, L3 GND, L4 P5V: the trace is declared on L2 and references the adjacent L3 GND plane. Nothing may assume the usual L1-signal/L2-GND/L3-PWR/L4-signal arrangement; roles come from the stackup declaration.
